artifact_observations.reasoning: The keys on the QWERTY keyboard lack distinct lettering. Instead of crisp characters, there are blurry, nonsensical white smudges. The keys themselves are partially fused, lacking proper separation gaps.
The transition between the screen bezel and the hinge mechanism is slightly soft and ill-defined. The plastic texture lacks the fine molding lines or screw holes typically seen on real hardware.

artifact_observations.location: Right edge of the keyboard base
artifact_observations.reasoning: The rightmost edge of the keyboard base seems to warp slightly inward rather than maintaining a straight geometric line consistent with the rest of the chassis.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the keyboard. In AI images, QWERTY keyboards often fail to render distinct, legible characters. Check if the 'keys' are just raised bumps without letters. Also, verify if the screen shows a realistic UI or just a generic picture. Real handheld computers usually show a home screen with icons when on.
